# Computational cost: Training and running MLLMs require significant resources, limiting CLIP score filtering, GPT-4 data generation. # Alignment across modalities:
Ensuring text, images, audio and other data are connected is technically complex. Training Gemini requires thousands of TPUs, still meaningfully very expensive. # Interpretability:

"Is the cup LEFT or RIGHT of the plate?" Weak for most models. Hard to understand why an MM-LLM makes certain decisions. # Spatial Video reasoning: "How many birds?" — unreliable beyond ~5. Still unsolved.
# Cross-modal alignment: Visual and text features poorly aligned. # Adversarial attacks:
Hidden text in images bypasses safety. # Improving with better connectors: Longer alignment pre-training.
# Active security concern: Red-teaming, image-text consistency checks. # Interpretability source:
Why did the model say X about the image? Largely unsolved. Attention visualization, probing. # Better customization: Usually text-only output.
